title: Classification of Auslander-Gorenstein monomial algebras: The acyclic case
summary: We give a linear algebraic classification of Auslander regular acyclic monomial algebras via the Bruhat factorisation of the Coxeter matrix. Namely, we show under mild assumptions that a monomial acyclic quiver algebra is Auslander regular if and only if its Coxeter matrix $C$ has a Bruhat factorisation $U_1 P U_2$ with $U_1$ the identity matrix.
